entities.name: Integrity protection maximum data rate
entities.description: Information element that specifies the maximum data rate for integrity protection.

entities.name: PDN connection established in S1 mode
entities.description: Condition where a PDN connection was established while the UE was in S1 mode.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Condition where the UE performs an inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode.

entities.name: UE operating in single-registration mode with N26 interface support
entities.description: Condition where the UE operates in single-registration mode and the network supports the N26 interface.

entities.name: No previous successful UE-requested PDU session modification
entities.description: Condition where the UE has not previously successfully performed a UE-requested PDU session modification to provide the integrity protection maximum data rate capability.

relations.description: The IE is included when the PDN connection was established in S1 mode.
The IE is included after an inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode.
The IE is included if the UE operates in single-registration mode and the network supports N26 interface.
The IE is included if the UE has not previously successfully performed UE-requested PDU session modification for this capability.
